task.title: Deploy the skeleton site by hand to the personal account
task.description:
## Why
A first deploy by hand proves the account, token and config work before any automation is built on them.

## Steps
1. In `web/`, set `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` in the shell from the password manager.
2. Build the site and run `npx wrangler deploy`.
3. Open the `workers.dev` address Wrangler prints and load the placeholder page.
4. Add a "Deploying by hand" section to `web/README.md` with these exact commands.

## Done when
- The placeholder page loads at the personal `workers.dev` address.
- The commands are written in `web/README.md`.

comments.author: dylan@dgoings.com
comments.body: Skipped by decision: the first deploy was done by the Deploy workflow instead of by hand.
